facts.value: This program is for individuals who enjoy speaking languages, exploring the countries where they are spoken, and understanding the differences in languages and communication. It is suitable for those interested in traveling and immersing themselves in other cultures.
Students can study three languages or combine two languages with subjects such as Law, Marketing, or Politics and International Relations.
Students can acquire specialist skills such as Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages (TESOL) or Technical Communication while studying languages.
